text:
alex.peo: Heads up — bridge day next Fri overlaps global all-hands. Folks want to take staggered half-day PTO (AM or PM) so we keep coverage. Payroll cutoff for carryover is Wed EOD. Can we allow half-day PTO conversion to a floating holiday for those with rollout conflicts? Need manager approval guidance and self-service steps.

jordan-manager: For eng: fine with AM/PM splits as long as handoff notes posted in the ticket. Approve in the People Ops portal? what's the exact flow?

sam-eng: I have a late deploy Thu night — will need PM off Fri. Will manager approval suffice or do we need People Ops sign-off?

maria-payroll: Payroll note: to be included in this pay cycle/carryover mapping, PTO entries must be in the system by Wed 11:59pm PST. If they come after cutoff they process next cycle. Contractors: conversions don't apply (see below).

alex.peo: Process we propose: 1) employee submits half-day PTO via People Ops portal; 2) manager approves; 3) employee tags request with "bridge-conversion" and short reason; 4) People Ops does final batch conversion to floating holiday for eligible employees before payroll run. Example self-service command (People Ops CLI):
```
/timeoff convert 0.5 --to floating --tag bridge-conversion --note "all-hands conflict"
```

payroll-bot: Reminder: payroll cutoff for June cycle is 1715640000 (Wed 23:59 PST). Please submit earlier to avoid misses.

maria-payroll: Also two clarifications: (a) Contractors cannot convert half-days to floating holidays — they must log a PTO day or unpaid time; (b) part-timers prorate eligibility — People Ops will check balances and follow up if insufficient.

jordan-manager: :thumbsup: I'll approve team requests once submitted and add handoff notes to the tickets. Jordan approves Sam.

sam-eng: Submitted and tagged. Thanks!

alex.peo: :white_check_mark: Noted. People Ops will run a conversion batch Thu morning for any manager-approved, tagged requests. If anyone hits any system error, ping me directly or DM @maria-payroll.

maria-payroll: I'll post a final reminder in #general tomorrow with the cutoff window.

payroll-bot: deposit-schedule-notice: next payroll run 1715660000
